title: 'Football 301': Arch Manning's NFL Draft stock isn't cooked and here's why

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: 'Football 301': Arch Manning's NFL Draft stock isn't cooked and here's why
sources.description: The constant social media barrage calling Arch "overrated" or a "bust" doesn't move Yahoo Sports' Nate Tice. He's seen enough from the process, traits and underlying play to keep faith in Manning's long-term NFL potential.
